maya: Heads up — seeing a bunch of multi-GPU jobs fail in eu-west-2 with NCCL errors (peer reset / timeout). Started ~08:12UTC. Affected jobs are p2p heavy (allreduce).
rahul: Can you paste the exact NCCL error lines and one example job id?
maya: job 0x7f2d4c, paste of logs: `NCCL WARN NET/IB : error event on qpn 0x12345: local length 65536 > path mtu 4096, send failed` and `unreachable (code 110)`
olga: that local length > path mtu line screams MTU/PMTU mismatch on RoCEv2. Any recent ToR or image rollouts?
maya: We pushed a kernel and mlx5 fw bump to a subset of eu-west racks last night (rollout tag: kernel-6.4-mlx5-2026-03). rollouts show ~30% of hosts updated.
rahul: Oof. Known interaction: newer mlx5 FW changes jumbo/segmentation behavior -> exposes PMTU blackholes if VXLAN/TOR doesn't advertise proper jumbo support.
sre-jen: Oncall looking. Can you run quick checks on an impacted host: `ip -d link show dev eth0`, `cat /sys/class/net/eth0/mtu`, `ibv_devinfo -v`, `rdma link show`? Also check `dmesg | grep mlx5`
maya: Running, pasting snippets:
```
root@gpu-42:~# cat /sys/class/net/eth0/mtu
4096
root@gpu-42:~# ip -d link show eth0
3: eth0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 4096 qdisc noqueue state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether aa:bb:cc:dd ee ff brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    vxlan id 4096 <...> 
root@gpu-42:~# ibv_devinfo -v
hca_id: mlx5_0
  fw_ver: 24.30.1020
  phys_port_cnt: 2
root@gpu-42:~# rdma link show
1: ib0 up mtu 65520
```

maya: note eth0 MTU advert is 4096 but rdma shows ib0 mtu 65520. That mismatch could produce fragmentation/seg faults on RoCEv2.
rahul: Exactly. Packets leave GID path with 65520 but ToR strips to 4096 -> intermediate fragmentation gets dropped by LL.
olga: Does our RoCE encapsulation use VXLAN on those racks? If so we might be double-encapsulating and losing outer MTU.
maya: Yes, overlay enabled for these hosts (vlan/vxlan). Tor config shows vxlan offload on, but some ToRs haven't been updated to respect the larger outer mtu.
sre-jen: Short term mitigation: force NCCL to fallback to TCP on impacted pools by setting envs on job wrapper: `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` and `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` — that will avoid RDMA but keeps jobs running. Cost: CPU+socket will increase per-token time for allreduce.
olga: Agree for mitigation. We should also mark the updated hosts as drama-canary and cordon them from p2p scheduling until we fix firmware/ToR config.
rahul: For a quick RoCE-specific shim, we can patch the node agent to set `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` and force `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 65520` only after ToR checks. But if ToR drops bigger frames, that will still blackhole.
maya: I can run a targeted canary: move 2 failing jobs to a pinned machine with older fw (non-updated) and re-run with NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1; results will tell us perf delta.
rahul: Also run `tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/pkts.pcap port 6811 or port 48000` and check if large UDP fragments get ICMP frag-needed. If we see ICMP type 3 code 4, that's PMTU problem.
maya: Captured — saw `ICMP type 3 code 4` from upstream - confirms PMTU blackhole.
olga: Plan proposal: 1) Emergency rollback of mlx5 fw on hosts with failures (small batch), 2) schedule ToR VXLAN config rollout to advertise jumbo support (and validate with a probe), 3) keep nodes cordoned and use NCCL_IB_DISABLE on affected workload queues, 4) longer term add a node-agent health probe to compare eth/ib MTU and auto-cordon.
sre-jen: I support. Need to weigh rollback risk vs ToR change risk. Rollback is quicker but still disruptive; ToR change touches network team and might be slower.
rahul: Rollback steps (quick): `systemctl stop node-agent`, `mlxupfw -r <old-fw>`, reboot; validation: `ibv_devinfo` fw_ver matches baseline and run an allreduce smoke loop. I'll draft a rollback runbook.
maya: I'll start canary rollback on 2 hosts now and enable NCCL_IB_DISABLE on the job scheduler for the eu-west p2p queue.
deploy-bot: Started job requeue for queue "eu-west-p2p" with override env NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 (job ids: 0x7f2d4c, 0x7f413a).
maya: Canary rollback completed on node gpu-42, smoke allreduce now passes with RDMA restored. Observed p99 latency back to expected.
olga: Great — track degraded throughput vs cost for those requeued jobs. We should estimate additional GPU-hours from TCP fallback and communicate to finance if it's >5% uplift.
rahul: I'll open a ticket with netops for ToR VXLAN jumbo advertise sweep and add a preflight probe script that checks `eth0 mtu == ib0 mtu` and emits metric `rdma_mtu_mismatch` to prometheus.
maya: Filed infra-6842 with logs and pcap attached.
sre-jen: I'll update the incident channel with mitigation summary and mark SLOs impacted. Also schedule maintenance window for full fw/toR coordinated rollout tomorrow 02:00UTC.
olga: Postmortem items: health probe, automated node cordon when mismatch, more granular rollout gating for fw updates, and a cost dashboard for fallback scenarios.
